Privacy Policy

Sample template wording for demo purposes only — not legal advice. Final text to be confirmed before launch.

Last updated: (to be set)

SenangJer ("we", "us"), operated by OMNITECH MARKETING SDN BHD (1548958-A), respects your privacy. This policy explains, in general terms, how we would collect and use personal information when you use this platform.

1. Information we collect

When you submit an application we may collect details such as your name, contact number, email, delivery or installation address, and the supporting documents you upload (for example identification and proof of address). We collect this only to process the service you request.

2. How we use it

Your information is used to verify eligibility, submit and process your application with the relevant service provider, keep you updated on status, and provide support. We do not sell your personal information.

3. Sharing

To complete an application we may share the necessary details with the telco or brand you selected and with parties involved in delivery or installation. They process the information under their own terms.

4. Retention & security

We aim to keep personal information only as long as needed for the purpose collected and to apply reasonable safeguards. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

5. Your choices

You may request access to or correction of your information, or ask about how it is handled, via the contact channels on this site.

These terms would govern your use of the SenangJer platform, operated by OMNITECH MARKETING SDN BHD (1548958-A).

1. About the platform

SenangJer is an independent multi-brand platform that helps you discover and apply for services from third-party providers. Brand names shown belong to their respective owners; listing a brand does not imply direct ownership or partnership unless clearly stated.

2. Applications

Submitting an application is a request to process a service on your behalf. Approval, pricing, availability and installation are subject to the relevant provider's own terms, checks and coverage. Figures shown on this site are samples and not a binding offer.

3. Your responsibilities

You agree to provide accurate information and genuine supporting documents, and confirm you are authorised to submit them. Providing false or incomplete details may delay or void an application.

4. Availability

Services, packages and promotions may change or be withdrawn at any time. Coverage results shown are indicative only.

5. Limitation

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for decisions, pricing or service delivered by third-party providers.

PDPA Notice

Sample template wording for demo purposes only — not legal advice. Final text to be confirmed before launch.

This notice describes, in general terms, how personal data would be handled under Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA).

Purpose

Personal data you provide is processed to verify, submit and manage the service applications you request through SenangJer, and to keep you informed of their status.

Consent

By submitting an application you would consent to your data being processed for these purposes and shared with the relevant provider and delivery or installation parties as needed to fulfil your request.

Your rights

Subject to the Act, you may request access to or correction of your personal data, and may withdraw consent, by contacting us. Withdrawing consent may mean we can no longer process an application.

Help centre

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about using SenangJer. Sample content for demo.

What is SenangJer?
SenangJer is a multi-brand platform that helps you compare and apply for home and business services — internet, mobile, TV, water and air, and home appliances — from several providers in one place.
Does it cost anything to apply?
Browsing and submitting an application through the platform is free. You only pay the provider for the plan or product you choose, based on their pricing.
Which brands are available?
The platform features a range of telco and home brands. Exact availability depends on your address and the provider's coverage. Use the Coverage checker to see what's offered at your postcode.
What documents do I need to apply?
Typically your identification and a recent proof of address (such as a utility bill). Some plans may need additional documents. The application form guides you on what to upload.
How long does installation take?
Timelines vary by provider, service type and location. After you apply, the provider confirms scheduling. You can follow progress on the Track Application page.
How do I track my application?
Go to Track Application and enter your reference number, or sign in to view all your applications in My Account.
Can I cancel or change my application?
Before it is processed by the provider, contact us as early as possible and we'll help where we can. Once a provider has begun processing, their cancellation terms apply.
Is my personal information safe?
We only collect what's needed to process your request and apply reasonable safeguards. See the Privacy Policy and PDPA notice for details.

Products

Every product we carry — full specification, compliance and photo status
⚠
Standby catalogue, not live. Every WiFi & Broadband price is transcribed from a dealer brochure supplied by the operator, with the sheet each plan came from named in Operator view. Where a sheet printed one figure, only one is shown; a struck-through price appears only where the sheet printed one. Where a figure was unreadable or a contract term was not printed, the card says so rather than filling the gap. Appliance and electronics specifications, warranty lines and product URLs are copied from LG Malaysia's own pages with the date read; LG publishes no prices, so those prices are empty rather than guessed. No compliance line is attributed to SIRIM, MCMC, Suruhanjaya Tenaga, SPAN or KKM, because no source read names them. No manufacturer photograph is used anywhere on this page — every physical product shows the photo slots still outstanding, and the broadband plan panels are AI-generated illustrations in each brand's own colour, labelled as such on the panel. They show no real device, name no model, and close no photograph slot: all 128 are still on the shopping list. The speed printed over each panel is the one on the brochure. Rows marked SAMPLE are placeholders.
